name: agentfloat
description: Budget-controlled MUSD wallet for AI agents on Mezo — x402 payments with on-chain spending caps.

scripts.//install-all: Installs every workspace. Run this once after cloning.
scripts.install-all: npm --prefix contract install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm install
scripts.//install-all-windows: If `npm --prefix ... install` puts node_modules in the wrong place on your machine, install each workspace by hand instead: cd contract && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd .. && npm install
scripts.//dev: Gateway (127.0.0.1:4022) + dashboard (http://localhost:5173) together. ROOT-ONLY SCRIPT: cd into server/ and `npm run dev` gives 'Missing script: dev'. Equivalent by hand in two terminals: (1) cd server && npm start   (2) cd frontend && npm run dev. Open http://localhost:5173 -- NOT the LAN IP, which is not a secure context and breaks Privy and wallet extensions.
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run gateway" "npm run web"
scripts.//dev:lan: Same as dev, but the dashboard listens on 0.0.0.0 for tunnels and hosted previews.
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n gateway,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run gateway" "npm run web:lan"
scripts.//web: Binds 127.0.0.1 only. That is deliberate: http://localhost:5173 is a SECURE CONTEXT, so WebCrypto (crypto.randomUUID) and injected wallets work. Open the printed LAN URL instead and Privy breaks.
scripts.//web:lan: Binds 0.0.0.0 for tunnels and hosted previews. Anyone on your LAN can then reach the dashboard and, through its /api proxy, the agent wallet -- do not use this on an untrusted network.
scripts.//contract: Hardhat tasks. Always the LOCAL binary — `npx hardhat` downloads 3.x, which rejects Node 20.
scripts.check-env: npm --prefix contract run hh -- run scripts/check-env.js --network mezoTestnet
scripts.deploy: npm --prefix contract run hh -- run scripts/deploy.js --network mezoTestnet
scripts.setup-agent: npm --prefix contract run hh -- run scripts/setup-agent.js --network mezoTestnet
scripts.//resume: Undo an EMERGENCY STOP from the CLI (no MetaMask needed): unpause the treasury and release float back to the agent.
scripts.//test:gateway: Offline tests for the gateway modules added in Wave 1: the x402 relay's SSRF guard, self-service budget ceilings and signature verification, and the Telegram alert renderer. No chain, no bot token, no network.
scripts.//test:deploy: Boots the real gateway in deployed mode (0.0.0.0, allowlist, admin token) and HTTP-tests the things that only break on a PaaS: CORS, the pause lock, PORT/HOST, expose headers. No chain writes, spends nothing.
scripts.//test:browser: Offline tests for the browser-only code paths: the wallet network state machine, the x402 signer/header logic, and the Permit2 approval. No browser needed.
scripts.test:browser: npm --prefix frontend run test:network && npm --prefix frontend run test:x402 && npm --prefix frontend run test:permit2 && npm --prefix frontend run test:autopay && npm --prefix frontend run test:charts
scripts.//test:relay: LIVE: spends 0.001 MUSD proving the relay end to end. Needs `npm run gateway` in another terminal and a funded, registered agent wallet in server/.env.
scripts.//test:onboarding: LIVE: the whole new-user walk — faucet, gas drip, Permit2 approval, first payment. Spends 10 MUSD + 0.00005 BTC + 0.001 MUSD and registers a throwaway agent. Needs `npm run gateway`.
scripts.//test:autopay:live: LIVE: automated spending against the chain — self-service caps, the predicted refusal, and a loop that stops itself. Spends 10 MUSD + 0.00005 BTC + 0.005 MUSD. Needs `npm run gateway`.
